er_v06_c16_b001_03: Myself! The first thing she asked was whether I'd been skipping meals again.
er_v06_c16_b001_04: Sounds like she knows exactly who you are.
er_v06_c16_b001_05: She was exiled to the lower levels. She can't go back to her old farm.
er_v06_c16_b001_06: But we're together again. Tonight, I know where she's sleeping.
er_v06_c16_b002_01: I've seen Mother! She's been moved out, someone's looking after her, and visits are registered.
er_v06_c16_b002_02: Does she know what happens next?
er_v06_c16_b002_03: She does. The research, the threat, and what we plan to publish. I told her everything.
er_v06_c16_b002_04: She said to let the protection staff confirm the arrangements first, then send the material out.
er_v06_c16_b002_06: She said I'm reckless enough for both of us. Someone in the family has to ask more questions.
er_v06_c16_b003_01: I had so many things prepared. I wanted to ask how she ate in there, why she didn't tell me sooner, whether anyone hurt her.
er_v06_c16_b003_03: Not a single one. I just called her 'Mom'.
er_v06_c16_b003_04: She said she heard me, and I didn't have to shout.
er_v06_c16_b003_05: You can ask the rest slowly.
er_v06_c16_b003_06: Yeah. Now we can take our time.
er_v06_c16_b003_07: I used to think that as long as I could get back up there, everything would return to how it was.
er_v06_c16_b003_08: But today, when I saw her, I didn't even think about the house up there.
er_v06_c16_b003_09: What about a place to live?
er_v06_c16_b003_10: We'll find something suitable down here first. My roommate said she'd help look, and I can keep working.
er_v06_c16_b003_11: Come pick out whatever you need.
er_v06_c16_b003_12: At full price. You've already helped us too much. I can't have you paying for everything from now on.
er_v06_c16_b003_14: But today, I want to thank you properly, once.
er_v06_c16_b003_15: All I could say then was that I wanted to save her. You helped me bring her home.
er_v06_c16_b004_01: The research on restoring nutrifruit seeds has been handed to independent researchers for verification. The representative of Pastel's station office is suspected of coercion and interference in the case and is now under investigation.
er_v06_c16_b004_02: The person concerned is currently under registered protection. The original embezzlement case is still under review; the investigation result does not constitute a final ruling.
er_v06_c16_b005_01: The registered protection arrangements have been confirmed. The family is permitted to register a residence in the lower levels and live together, and may carry on normal daily activities. Contact person and address are on file; contact must be maintained during the review of the original case.
er_v06_c17_b001_01: Hello. Eleanor says that when you buy things here, the owner tells you the flaws first.
er_v06_c17_b001_03: That the owner isn't always good with words, but isn't a bad person.
er_v06_c17_b001_05: I'd like to buy some household goods. There's still a lot missing where we live.
er_v06_c17_b001_07: She's working. Before she left, she told me not to grab everything just because it's cheap.
er_v06_c17_b002_01: When I used to tell her that, she pretended not to hear.
er_v06_c17_b002_02: She's very careful with money now.
er_v06_c17_b002_03: She could always do arithmetic. She just never had to count for herself before.
er_v06_c17_b002_04: She told me what you did for her.
er_v06_c17_b002_06: I know. But when she talks about herself, she says far less than when she talks about you.
er_v06_c17_b002_07: Probably thinks there's nothing worth mentioning.
er_v06_c17_b002_08: Or maybe she's waiting for me to ask.
er_v06_c17_b003_01: The research was returned. Of course that doesn't sit well with me.
er_v06_c17_b003_02: But don't let her think bringing me back is something she has to apologise for.
er_v06_c17_b004_01: The material has been sent out. I'll keep cooperating with the review. The rest will take time, step by step.
er_v06_c17_b004_02: You were right to get me transferred before publishing. The people with the least protection shouldn't always be the ones paying the price.
er_v06_c17_b005_01: That's all. Don't refuse to take my money just because it's me.
er_v06_c17_b005_02: You two even say the same thing.
er_v06_c17_b005_03: In some ways, she really is like me.
er_v06_c17_b005_04: When she talks about this place lately, it's not just about what she bought.
er_v06_c17_b005_06: You'll have to ask her yourself. I'm not going to finish her sentences for her.
er_v06_c18_b001_02: She did. Bought some things, paid for them.
er_v06_c18_b001_03: Did you only talk about shopping?
er_v06_c18_b001_06: She told me to ask you myself.
er_v06_c18_b002_01: I brought some goods. Not an excuse. They're actually sellable.
er_v06_c18_b002_02: I didn't say it was an excuse.
er_v06_c18_b002_03: You'd better not even think it.
er_v06_c18_b002_04: My mother gets up earlier than I do now. Two days ago I woke up and found her sitting there repairing an old tray.
er_v06_c18_b002_06: She says if her hands aren't doing something, she starts thinking about what happened in there.
er_v06_c18_b002_07: I handed her the tools and sat with her for a while.
er_v06_c18_b002_09: Yeah. Nothing special. Just sat for a while.
er_v06_c18_b003_01: I always thought that once she was out, I'd know what to do next.
er_v06_c18_b003_03: Work continues, the room needs tidying, meals have to be made. I know all that.
er_v06_c18_b003_04: It's just... I don't need to invent a reason to come here so I can ask you for help.
er_v06_c18_b003_05: You don't need a reason to come here.
er_v06_c18_b004_01: I'll still come to sell goods. You don't have to ask me what happened every time.
er_v06_c18_b004_03: As a regular. Ordinary customers don't know what you buy.
er_v06_c19_b001_01: There's something we need to settle first. I haven't forgotten the crate from the man pretending to be my uncle.
er_v06_c19_b001_03: You did make it right afterward, and you've told me things first ever since.
er_v06_c19_b001_04: I'm willing to trust you again. But what you did that time was still wrong.
er_v06_c19_b001_05: I know. From now on, if I know about a danger, I'll tell you first.
er_v06_c19_b001_06: Remember that. Don't forget it in two days.
er_v06_c19_b003_01: I like you too. Every time the door opens, I look up hoping it's you.
er_v06_c19_b003_02: ...So that was why. Twice you got the scales out when I had brought nothing to sell.
er_v06_c19_b003_03: I had to give myself something to do.
er_v06_c19_b003_04: Then no hiding when I find fault with you. You can still change your mind.
er_v06_c19_b003_07: Then from now on, I won't have to say I was 'just passing by.'
er_v06_c19_b004_01: I want to know you better. But can we take it slowly?
er_v06_c19_b004_02: Yes. I'm not asking you to sign a lifetime contract today.
er_v06_c19_b004_03: Just don't pretend you didn't hear me.
er_v06_c19_b005_01: I care about you. But not that way.
er_v06_c19_b005_03: You telling me directly is better than letting me guess.
er_v06_c19_b005_04: You don't have to repay me for the help I gave you.
er_v06_c19_b005_05: I know. I'm not trying to repay a debt.
er_v06_c19_b005_06: I'll still come sell goods in a couple of days. Act normal then.
er_v06_c19_b006_01: I said some harsh things before. I want to add one thing today.
er_v06_c19_b006_02: Thank you for always treating me like someone who can do things for herself.
er_v06_c19_b006_04: Now I believe it. If you ever need me for something, you can come find me.
er_v06_c20_b001_01: I saw a batch of goods you might want. I didn't agree to anything for you.
er_v06_c20_b001_02: Why didn't you bring it directly?
er_v06_c20_b001_03: You said it yourself: look at the goods first, then listen to the person.
er_v06_c20_b001_04: I asked where it came from, and what's broken. When the person arrives, you look for yourself.
er_v06_c20_b001_05: You know not to make decisions for me.
er_v06_c20_b001_06: Of course. I just wanted you to know, this time I'm bringing you business.
er_v06_c20_b002_01: Well? I picked well, didn't I?
er_v06_c20_b002_02: You didn't hide the flaws. That's good.
er_v06_c20_b002_03: I was asking about my eye, not my character!
er_v06_c20_b003_01: Not suitable? Then don't buy it. It's not as if you have to buy something just because I brought it.
er_v06_c20_b003_02: Will you help me look next time?
er_v06_c20_b003_03: Yes. But first I need to figure out where I went wrong this time.
er_v06_c20_b004_01: My mother says my tone when bargaining sounds more and more like yours.
er_v06_c20_b004_02: Does she think that's a good thing?
er_v06_c20_b004_03: She says at least now I know what I'm talking about.
er_v06_c20_b004_05: I said the teacher is average. The student is the smart one.
er_v06_c20_b005_01: So what does the teacher get?
er_v06_c20_b005_02: A girlfriend this clever isn't enough?
er_v06_c20_b006_01: Next time you could teach some other beginners.
er_v06_c20_b006_02: Fine. First lesson: don't fall down in the same place twice.
er_v06_c19_b002_01: No goods today. There is something I want to tell you.
er_v06_c19_b002_02: I was hoping you would come.
er_v06_c19_b002_03: ...Then why do you always ask what I am selling?
er_v06_c19_b002_04: I was afraid asking too soon would scare you off.
er_v06_c19_b002_05: Oh, please. I come here more often than I have goods to sell.
er_v06_c19_b002_06: I wonder whether you found anything good today, whether your lunch has gone cold again, whether you argued with another difficult customer.
er_v06_c19_b002_07: Mother is safe now, and I still want to see you every day.
er_v06_c19_b002_09: Wait. Let me finish. I like you.
er_v06_c19_b002_10: There. Your turn. No changing the subject to price tags this time.
